catalog.title: Seiko V2
catalog.note: JDM catalogue (second volume, 1978). Each caption prints the ref (●QNF884) and list price (円), then the movement (a four-digit calibre such as 7830, 2220, 1600, 4300, an LCD module such as A158 or F033, or a family code such as 48KQW, 58KQW, 75TPW, 11S, 17QS, SV, 16NC, 88ST) with jewels (石) where printed and the case material (SS, HSS, SGP, HGP, GC, ASGP/AWGP/APDP/ACRP A-grade plated, WGP, PDP, GPDP, GF/WGF, TSGP, SILV, 14K, ALM/ALH light alloy, SHA, TIN NSB titanium, PC plastic), a crystal/feature line, the case code printed as CCCC<case-dial> (the bracketed part is kept as caseDialCode, the full line in `code`) and a box with the bracelet/chain/cord code (X…) or the strap width in mm. `caliber` is the printed movement number, or the four-digit prefix of the case code where the movement is printed as a family code; family codes whose case code has a two-digit prefix (11S, 17QS, 88ST) leave it blank, and no CCCC-NNNN case–movement ref is printed. Several prices and codes are struck through and corrected by hand in this copy; the corrected value is kept and the change noted. The three pair-watch pages print only ref and price. Printed page numbers are not continuous with the scan (pages are missing), so pages are labelled by scan index.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of 250 DPI renders (Claude, Oct 2026), every record verified against caption crops placed beside its own photo crop.
